pages.title: Geodesics
pages.text: $(thing)Geodesics$()$(br2)In curved spacetime a falling body takes the straightest path there is - a geodesic. Gravity is not a force; it is the shape of the road. Unlocks the Geodesic Compass.

$(thing)Insight$(): 140$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): General Relativity, Geometric Topology.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Proof Mass, 1 Metric Tensor.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A mass M is squeezed until light cannot escape it. Write the radius r at which that happens, from gravity's constant G and the speed of light c.
